import nuke from NukeFaceTrack import core, ui import importlib
# Reload to ensure Nuke sees the new Class and Functions importlib.reload(core) importlib.reload(ui)
def run_tool(): node = nuke.selectedNode() if not node: nuke.message("Select a node first.") return
p = ui.FaceTrackUI(node) if p.showModalDialog(): rng_str = p.range.value() try: first, last = map(int, rng_str.split('-')) except: nuke.message("Invalid range. Use format: 1-10") return
proc = core.FaceProcessor() data = proc.run_range(node, first, last)
if data: ui.create_all_tools(data, node) else: nuke.message("Processing failed: No faces detected.")
run_tool()
